name: 3D Scientific Visualization
summary: A spatial model on a dark instrument field: cross-sections, exploded views, controlled camera orbits and labelled structure. Precision over drama.

identity.visual_language: lit forms on a dark field with thin technical overlays
identity.composition_philosophy: the object is the hero; labels hang off it on leader lines
identity.environment: empty lab space with a faint grid
identity.realism: stylised-3D to photoreal depending on assets

palette.contrast_strategy: light text on dark; accent marks the part being discussed

typography.scale_and_hierarchy: small labels, one large figure per beat

composition.principles: centred or off-centre object with radial label placement

design_system.lighting: key and rim, soft shadow on the grid

motion.grammar: Smooth, damped camera and part motion; labels arrive after the form they name.

camera.language: orbits and pushes around the object

motion.effects_2d3d: CSS 3D transforms or Three.js; section planes
motion.stillness_policy: slow orbit keeps the frame alive

audio_direction.sfx: quiet instrument ticks on label arrival

rendering.strategy: CSS 3D / SVG isometric for most cases; Three.js only when a real model is needed. Pre-rendered Blender plates are an additional dependency and not available here.
rendering.resource_notes: True 3D (Three.js) is possible on this host but heavier; isometric SVG and CSS 3D approximate most needs.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Real 3D fidelity is limited to what CSS 3D, SVG or Three.js can do on 8 GB.
Pre-rendered Blender scenes are an additional dependency.
Dark field plus thin labels needs care for small-screen legibility.
example_scenes: An exploded isometric stack with leader-line labels that rise one by one.
